purpose: Distinguish fixed-retrieval failure from usable event-specific EO information
outer_split: Fixed calendar-year boundary; all earlier closed storms; same-gauge fits
inner_split: Latest two feasible earlier-year folds; all their eligible cases
primary_point_score: Mean hourly MAE across next 24h; point forecasts are not empirical ensembles
retrieval_score: Existing empirical-ensemble CRPS on matched donor pools
